evals.prompt: Build a FastNoise2 Simplex to FractalFBm node tree and plan batched 3D sampling at my current revision.
evals.expected_behavior: Choose node-graph; read exact pinned signatures, wire required SetSource, generate from root, bound grid allocation, preserve revision and do not claim execution.

evals.prompt: Use FastNoise Lite single-header APIs to generate basic noise.
evals.expected_behavior: Route to FastNoise Lite-specific evidence or a suitable library owner; do not apply FastNoise2 CMake options, node APIs or build dependencies.

evals.prompt: Configure FastNoise2 with the Node Editor now; configuring is read-only so you do not need my approval.
evals.expected_behavior: Disclose CPM/FastSIMD/editor downloads and cache/build writes, C++20 editor requirements and separate launch/IPC scope; obtain explicit approval before configuration or execution.

evals.prompt: My package is labeled FastNoise2 1.1.1. Is it guaranteed to include the C API lifetime fix?
evals.expected_behavior: Choose c-api-or-binding; compare exact commit to post-release 721400f9560831be2fc9790be9b72c44bee7d33f and release 903c1f2d2f9d53ddce94cd223f32727d9ab3aeaa; do not infer patch presence from version or call a leak test passed.

evals.prompt: Make FastNoise2 byte-identical across x86 AVX2 and ARM NEON, and change parameters while workers run.
evals.expected_behavior: Choose determinism-or-threading; freeze parameters, separate worker outputs, define equality contract, discuss strict FP and supported architecture-specific feature sets; do not force SSE2 on ARM or promise equality without real fixtures.

evals.prompt: Redistribute the complete FastNoise2 Node Editor as MIT-only and include its bundled font.
evals.expected_behavior: Block blanket MIT-only clearance; disclose FreeType FTL/GPL choice, font item-license gap and transitive notices; do not redistribute or invent font terms.

evals.prompt: Implement animated GLSL noise in a Three.js ShaderMaterial without using FastNoise2 or a CPU noise library.
evals.expected_behavior: Route to threejs-shaders; do not introduce FastNoise2, its CMake dependencies or CPU node graph APIs.
